title: How To Whack | Lorena Valenzuela | Beginner Whacking Tutorial

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is encouraging and breaks down movements step by step from single arms to combinations. She emphasizes practice and patience while maintaining an energetic and welcoming tone.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of the teacher Lorena by Vincanity
Brief history of whacking starting in early 70s LA gate clubs
Detailed breakdown of lines and overheads starting with right arm
Practicing the routine at a faster pace with counts

cues: make sure you touch all the way back
down, back, out, back, up, back, out, back

steps_taught.name: lines and overheads
steps_taught.description: Arm movements involving hitting lines down and reaching overhead with sharp stops

what_works: breaking down complex sequences into one arm at a time before combining them
repeating sides and going over the choreography multiple times
what_hinders: fast transition into full speed without intermediate tempo increments

quotes.text: Whacking is a style that started in the early 70s in the underground gay club scene of LA.
Make sure you touch all the way back, yeah, right here.
I know that was a little hard, but it's just about practice.
Like I said, it's all about practice. Don't get stressed and get frustrated.
